name: Auto-Cleanup AWS Logs
description: Automatically cleans up AWS logs after analysis is complete

actions.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; if (Test-Path 'temp-logs') { Write-Host '🧹 Auto-cleaning AWS logs after analysis...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'temp-logs'; Write-Host '✅ AWS logs cleaned up automatically!' -ForegroundColor Green }"
